macro.title: Fed Governor Barr says he'll support rate hike if inflation doesn't ease - CNBC
macro.summary: The policymaker said he's concerned about "broader price pressures taking hold" as inflation has prevailed above the Fed's 2% target.

macro.title: Toyota's hybrid RAV4 is in demand as dealers wait for more supply - CNBC
macro.summary: When Toyota announced the new version of its SUV, it said the RAV4 would only be available as a hybrid and that production would be limited at first.

macro.title: Lowe's launches major effort to help close America's skilled trades gap - Fox Business
macro.summary: Lowe's Foundation launched a coalition with Nvidia, General Motors and over 75 partners to train and certify 1 million skilled tradespeople by 2035.
